title: test(core): add table drag eval harness
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add `eval/` harness for headless table column-drag (`moveColumn`) testing, plus `pnpm eval` script.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Vitest covers unit behavior; this eval verifies real editor column-drag interactions do not corrupt table rows/cells after reorder.
仅证明harness可用，仅提交表格相关的的9个测试用例

## Changes / 变更内容

- `eval/`: table-drag YAML corpus, Python harness, `table-ops-bridge` (tsup + jsdom)
- `package.json`: add `pnpm eval` → `sh eval/run.sh`

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm eval -- --verbose` passes locally
- [x] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes

备注：由于使用的Key可能影响代码执行，未使用LLM-as-a-judge进行判断结果，更好的方案需要使用这种方式作为验证方式之一

+# Nexus Table Drag Eval
+
+针对 **表格列拖动（`moveColumn`）** 的 headless 评测框架。仅加载 `corpus/table-drag.yaml`，
+通过真实 `createEditor` + 模拟列把手拖动，断言列重排后单元格守恒。
+
+## 架构
+
+```
+corpus/table-drag.yaml → Dataset → Runner → table-ops-bridge.mjs → Evaluator → Reporter
+```
+
+| 模块 | 文件 | 职责 |
+|------|------|------|
+| Dataset | `harness/dataset.py` | 加载 `table-drag.yaml` |
+| Runner | `harness/runner.py` | 打包并驱动 `table-ops-bridge` |
+| Evaluator | `harness/evaluator.py` | oracle 对照列重排结果 |
+| Reporter | `harness/reporter.py` | 输出报告 |
+
+## 环境
+
+```bash
+python3 -m venv eval/.venv
+eval/.venv/bin/pip install -r eval/requirements.txt
+pnpm install   # 仓库根目录，提供 tsup 与 core 依赖
+```
+
+## 用法
+
+```bash
+./eval/run.sh
+./eval/run.sh --tag wide
+./eval/run.sh --id wellformed
+./eval/run.sh --verbose --json --rebuild
+```
+
+## 用例格式
+
+见 `corpus/table-drag.yaml`。每条用例 `id` 必须以 `tabledrag-` 开头。
+
+`expect` 常用字段：
+
+- `tableMove: { from, to }` — 拖哪列到哪列（0 基）
+- `tableLayout` — 模拟宽表视口（`viewportWidth`、`columnWidths` 等）
+- `normalizePipes: true` — 保存后表格行必须以 `|` 开头
+- `tableCountAfter` / `tableIndex` / `secondTableUnchanged` — 多表场景
+
+## 判定结果
+
+| Outcome | 含义 |
+|---------|------|
+| `ok` | 列重排与 oracle 一致 |
+| `degraded` | 未渲染出表格 widget |
+| `table-corruption` | 行列错乱、丢单元格、宽表无法放置等 |
+| `crash` / `timeout` | Node 进程崩溃或超时 |
+
+## 目录
+
+```
+eval/
+├── run.sh
+├── run_eval.py
+├── requirements.txt
+├── corpus/table-drag.yaml
+├── harness/
+└── bridge/
+    ├── table-ops-bridge.ts
+    ├── setup-dom.ts
+    ├── tsup.config.ts
+    └── dist/          # 打包产物（git 忽略）
+```

+# 表格「列拖动重排」用例（真实 moveColumn）
+#
+# 凡 id 以 `tabledrag-` 开头的用例，harness 会用真实 headless 编辑器渲染表格，
+# 再模拟拖动列把手（真实 grip mousedown→mousemove→mouseup，触发真实 moveColumn），
+# 然后断言这是一次「纯列重排」：
+#   - 拖动后各行列数一致（表头不得与数据行错位）
+#   - 行数不变
+#   - 每一行的单元格集合守恒（无丢失 / 无重复 / 无串列）
+#
+# `expect.tableMove: {from, to}` 指定拖动哪一列到哪一列（0 基，数据列）。
+# `expect.tableLayout` 可选，模拟宽表 / 视口（仅 headless 桥使用）：
+#   viewportWidth  可见视口宽度（px）
+#   scrollLeft     横向滚动偏移（px）
+#   columnWidths   各数据列宽度（px）；省略时按单元格文本长度估算
+# `expect.normalizePipes`  为 true 时，保存后所有含 | 的表格行必须以 | 开头
+# `expect.tableCountAfter` 拖动后文档中表格 widget 数量
+# `expect.tableIndex`      操作第几个表格（0 基，默认 0）
+# `expect.secondTableUnchanged` 为 true 时，第二个表格块内容必须不变
+#
+# ⚠️ 说明：其中多条用例目前会判为 `table-corruption`（🧱）——这正是要暴露的真实
+# 缺陷：当某一行（尤其表头）省略了行首竖线时，列重排会丢单元格、行列错位。
+# `tabledrag-wellformed` 作为对照，良构表应判为 ✅ 守恒。
+
+cases:
+  - id: tabledrag-user-report
+    input: |-
+      姓名 | 年龄 | 职位  |  |
+      | --- | --- | ---  | --- |
+      | 张三 | 25 | 提示词工程师  |  |
+      | 李四 | 30 | 测开工程师  |  |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, ragged, regression]
+    note: 用户原始复现——表头缺行首竖线、带尾部空列，拖动「年龄」「职位」互换
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 1, to: 2 }
+
+  - id: tabledrag-header-no-leading-pipe
+    input: |-
+      姓名 | 年龄 | 职位
+      | --- | --- | --- |
+      | 张三 | 25 | 工程师 |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, ragged]
+    note: 表头缺行首竖线（且无尾竖线），拖动第 0 列到第 2 列
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 0, to: 2 }
+
+  - id: tabledrag-header-no-trailing-pipe
+    input: |-
+      | 姓名 | 年龄 | 职位
+      | --- | --- | --- |
+      | 张三 | 25 | 工程师 |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, ragged]
+    note: 表头缺行尾竖线，拖动第 2 列到第 0 列
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 2, to: 0 }
+
+  - id: tabledrag-bare-no-pipes
+    input: |-
+      a | b | c
+      --- | --- | ---
+      1 | 2 | 3
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, ragged]
+    note: 所有行都无首尾竖线，拖动第 0 列到第 1 列
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 0, to: 1 }
+
+  - id: tabledrag-trailing-empty-column
+    input: |-
+      | 姓名 | 年龄 | 职位 |  |
+      | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+      | 张三 | 25 | 工程师 |  |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table]
+    note: 良构但带尾部空列，拖动第 1 列到第 2 列（列数应始终一致）
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 1, to: 2 }
+
+  - id: tabledrag-wellformed
+    input: |-
+      | a | b | c |
+      | --- | --- | --- |
+      | 1 | 2 | 3 |
+      | 4 | 5 | 6 |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, control]
+    note: 对照组——完全良构的表格，列重排必须守恒（应判 ✅）
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 0, to: 2 }
+
+  - id: tabledrag-wide-roadmap-search-commands
+    input: |-
+      | # | Feature | Package | Priority | Status | Needs OpenSpec | Notes |
+      | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+      | 2 | Whole-word matching | plugin-search | P1 | done | No | wholeWord option via buildSearchPattern with \b boundaries |
+      | 15 | Regex search | plugin-search | P1 | done | No | regexp option landed alongside whole-word; invalid-regex guarded |
+      | 16 | Command / search history | plugin-search + plugin-slash | P2 | done | Yes | Host-injected storage (no implicit localStorage) — add-search-query-history + add-slash-recent-command-history |
+      | 17 | Fuzzy search | plugin-search | P2 | planned | No | Evaluate fzf-like algorithm vs. third-party lib; needs backtracking matcher |
+      | 3 | Slash command sorting + limit | plugin-slash | P0 | done | Yes | Landed alongside the floating menu UI — see openspec/changes/add-slash-menu-ui |
+      | 27 | Slash command floating menu UI | plugin-slash + electron-demo | P0 | done | Yes | createSlashMenuUI(editor, options) — see openspec/changes/add-slash-menu-ui |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, wide, layout, regression]
+    note: Roadmap 宽表（约 2× 视口）——拖动 Feature 列到 Package 列时，鼠标在视口内始终落在源列上，无法放置到相邻列
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 1, to: 2 }
+      tableLayout:
+        viewportWidth: 800
+        columnWidths: [40, 760, 180, 70, 70, 110, 420]
+
+  - id: tabledrag-ragged-normalize-leading-pipe
+    input: |-
+      姓名 | 年龄 | 职位  |  |
+      | --- | --- | ---  | --- |
+      | 张三 | 25 | 提示词工程师  |  |
+      | 李四 | 30 | 测开工程师  |  |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, ragged, normalize]
+    note: 表头缺行首竖线但已渲染为表格——列拖动保存后应补全各行首 |，且列重排正确
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 1, to: 2 }
+      normalizePipes: true
+
+  - id: tabledrag-adjacent-tables-no-merge
+    input: |-
+      | a | b | c |
+      | --- | --- | --- |
+      | 1 | 2 | 3 |
+
+      | x | y | z |
+      | --- | --- | --- |
+      | 4 | 5 | 6 |
+    tags: [tabledrag, table, adjacent]
+    note: 两个相邻良构表格——拖动上方表格列时，不得与下方表格合并，且下方表格内容不变
+    expect:
+      tableMove: { from: 0, to: 2 }
+      tableIndex: 0
+      tableCountAfter: 2
+      secondTableUnchanged: true

+"""Nexus-Editor Eval Harness —— Core 解析器健壮性评测。
+
+四模块流水线（对齐参考 harness 的 Dataset → Runner → Evaluator → Reporter）：
+    dataset.py    加载残缺 Markdown 用例（YAML）
+    runner.py     打包并驱动 Node 解析桥，产出 RunResult
+    evaluator.py  规则评测，判定 Outcome / 分数
+    reporter.py   rich 表格 + 基线回归（纯文本回退）
+    main.py       串联流水线，返回门禁退出码
+"""
+
+__all__ = ["dataset", "runner", "evaluator", "reporter", "env", "main"]

+"""模块 1：Dataset —— 加载 table-drag.yaml 用例。"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from . import env
+
+try:
+    import yaml
+except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:  # pragma: no cover
+    raise SystemExit(
+        "缺少依赖 pyyaml。请先安装：\n"
+        "  python3 -m venv eval/.venv && eval/.venv/bin/pip install -r eval/requirements.txt"
+    ) from exc
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TestCase:
+    id: str
+    input: str
+    source_file: str
+    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+    note: str = ""
+    expect: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+
+def load_dataset(corpus_file: Path | None = None) -> list[TestCase]:
+    """加载 eval/corpus/table-drag.yaml。"""
+    path = corpus_file or env.CORPUS_FILE
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"未找到语料文件：{path}")
+
+    doc = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
+    raw_cases = doc.get("cases", [])
+    if not isinstance(raw_cases, list):
+        raise ValueError(f"{path.name} 顶层应为 cases 列表")
+
+    cases: list[TestCase] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for raw in raw_cases:
+        case_id = raw.get("id")
+        if not case_id:
+            raise ValueError(f"{path.name} 中存在缺少 'id' 的用例")
+        if case_id in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"用例 id 重复：{case_id!r}")
+        if not str(case_id).lower().startswith(env.TABLE_DRAG_PREFIX):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"用例 {case_id!r} 必须以 {env.TABLE_DRAG_PREFIX!r} 开头（仅支持 table-drag 语料）"
+            )
+        if "input" not in raw:
+            raise ValueError(f"用例 {case_id!r} 缺少 'input'")
+        seen.add(case_id)
+        cases.append(
+            TestCase(
+                id=case_id,
+                input=raw["input"],
+                source_file=path.name,
+                tags=tuple(raw.get("tags", []) or []),
+                note=raw.get("note", "") or "",
+                expect=dict(raw.get("expect", {}) or {}),
+            )
+        )
+    return cases
+
+
+def filter_cases(
+    cases: list[TestCase], tag: str | None, id_substr: str | None
+) -> list[TestCase]:
+    result = cases
+    if tag:
+        result = [c for c in result if tag in c.tags]
+    if id_substr:
+        result = [c for c in result if id_substr in c.id]
+    return result

+"""模块 3：Evaluator —— 表格列拖动规则判定。"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import Enum
+
+from .dataset import TestCase
+from .runner import RunResult
+
+
+class Outcome(str, Enum):
+    OK = "ok"
+    DEGRADED = "degraded"
+    TABLE_CORRUPTION = "table-corruption"
+    CRASH = "crash"
+    TIMEOUT = "timeout"
+
+
+HARD_FAILURES = {
+    Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+    Outcome.CRASH,
+    Outcome.TIMEOUT,
+}
+
+_SCORE = {
+    Outcome.OK: 1.0,
+    Outcome.DEGRADED: 0.5,
+}
+
+
+@dataclass
+class EvalScore:
+    case_id: str
+    outcome: Outcome
+    score: float
+    passed: bool
+    reason: str
+    table_op_ms: float = 0.0
+    table_moved: str | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def is_hard_failure(self) -> bool:
+        return self.outcome in HARD_FAILURES
+
+    @property
+    def total_ms(self) -> float:
+        return self.table_op_ms
+
+
+class Evaluator:
+    @staticmethod
+    def _split_row_cells(line: str) -> list[str]:
+        s = line.strip()
+        if s.startswith("|"):
+            s = s[1:]
+        if s.endswith("|"):
+            s = s[:-1]
+        return [c.strip() for c in s.split("|")]
+
+    def _parse_table(self, md: str) -> list[list[str]]:
+        return [self._split_row_cells(line) for line in md.split("\n") if line.strip()]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _split_table_blocks(md: str) -> list[str]:
+        return [block.strip() for block in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", md) if "|" in block]
+
+    def _oracle_move(self, before: str, frm: int, to: int) -> list[list[str]]:
+        out: list[list[str]] = []
+        for row in self._parse_table(before):
+            if 0 <= frm < len(row) and 0 <= to < len(row):
+                rr = row[:]
+                rr.insert(to, rr.pop(frm))
+                out.append(rr)
+            else:
+                out.append(row[:])
+        return out
+
+    def _make(
+        self,
+        case: TestCase,
+        result: RunResult,
+        outcome: Outcome,
+        reason: str,
+        *,
+        table_moved: str | None = None,
+    ) -> EvalScore:
+        return EvalScore(
+            case_id=case.id,
+            outcome=outcome,
+            score=_SCORE.get(outcome, 0.0),
+            passed=outcome not in HARD_FAILURES,
+            reason=reason,
+            table_op_ms=result.table_op_ms,
+            table_moved=table_moved,
+        )
+
+    def _check_table_op(self, case: TestCase, result: RunResult) -> EvalScore:
+        move = case.expect.get("tableMove") or {"from": 0, "to": 1}
+        frm, to = int(move.get("from", 0)), int(move.get("to", 1))
+        moved = f"{frm}→{to}"
+        expect = case.expect
+
+        if result.table_op_missing or result.missing:
+            if result.table_op_batch_failure == "timeout" or result.batch_failure == "timeout":
+                return self._make(case, result, Outcome.TIMEOUT, "列拖动全局超时", table_moved=moved)
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                "列拖动进程崩溃（无结果行）", table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        op = result.table_op
+        if op.get("status") == "throw":
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                f"列拖动抛异常：{op.get('error', '?')}", table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        before, after = op.get("before"), op.get("after")
+        if after is None:
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.DEGRADED,
+                op.get("error") or "未渲染出表格 widget", table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        layout = expect.get("tableLayout") or {}
+        if layout and op.get("status") == "noop":
+            table_w = op.get("tableWidth")
+            view_w = op.get("viewportWidth")
+            ratio = f"（表宽约 {table_w}px / 视口约 {view_w}px）" if table_w and view_w else ""
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                f"宽表列拖动未落到目标列：文档未变化{ratio}——拖动 {moved} 后仍无法放置到其他列",
+                table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        if expect.get("normalizePipes") and not op.get("pipesNormalized"):
+            sample = (op.get("nonPipeTableLines") or ["?"])[0]
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                f"表格已渲染但保存后未补全行首竖线，例如：{sample}",
+                table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        want_tables = expect.get("tableCountAfter")
+        if want_tables is not None:
+            got = op.get("tableWidgetCount")
+            if got != want_tables:
+                return self._make(
+                    case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                    f"拖动后表格 widget 数量应为 {want_tables}，实为 {got}",
+                    table_moved=moved,
+                )
+
+        if expect.get("secondTableUnchanged") and not op.get("secondTableUnchanged"):
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                "拖动上方表格列后，下方相邻表格内容被改变（可能发生合并或串写）",
+                table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        expected = self._oracle_move(before or "", frm, to)
+        actual = self._parse_table(after)
+
+        table_idx = int(expect.get("tableIndex", 0))
+        before_blocks = self._split_table_blocks(before or "")
+        after_blocks = self._split_table_blocks(after or "")
+        if before_blocks and (table_idx > 0 or expect.get("tableCountAfter") is not None):
+            if table_idx >= len(before_blocks):
+                return self._make(
+                    case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                    f"文档中只有 {len(before_blocks)} 个表格块，无法检查 index={table_idx}",
+                    table_moved=moved,
+                )
+            expected = self._oracle_move(before_blocks[table_idx], frm, to)
+            actual = (
+                self._parse_table(after_blocks[table_idx])
+                if table_idx < len(after_blocks)
+                else []
+            )
+
+        counts = [len(r) for r in actual]
+        if len(set(counts)) > 1:
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                f"列拖动后各行列数不一致：{counts}（表头与数据行错位）",
+                table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        if actual != expected:
+            detail = "整体与正确重排不符"
+            for i in range(max(len(expected), len(actual))):
+                exp = expected[i] if i < len(expected) else None
+                act = actual[i] if i < len(actual) else None
+                if exp != act:
+                    detail = f"第 {i} 行：应为 {exp}，实为 {act}"
+                    break
+            return self._make(
+                case, result, Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION,
+                f"列拖动 {moved} 结果错误——{detail}",
+                table_moved=moved,
+            )
+
+        return self._make(
+            case, result, Outcome.OK,
+            f"列拖动 {moved} 与正确重排逐格一致（各行 {counts[0] if counts else 0} 列）",
+            table_moved=moved,
+        )
+
+    def evaluate(self, cases: list[TestCase], results: list[RunResult]) -> list[EvalScore]:
+        by_id = {r.case_id: r for r in results}
+        return [self._check_table_op(c, by_id[c.id]) for c in cases]

+"""表格列拖动 Eval 入口：Dataset → Runner → Evaluator → Reporter
+
+用法：
+    ./eval/run.sh                          # 跑 table-drag.yaml 全部用例
+    ./eval/run.sh --tag ragged             # 按标签过滤
+    ./eval/run.sh --id user-report         # 按 id 子串过滤
+    ./eval/run.sh --verbose --json --rebuild
+
+无硬失败时退出码 0，否则 1。
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+
+from . import env
+from .dataset import filter_cases, load_dataset
+from .evaluator import Evaluator
+from .reporter import Reporter, build_report, print_json
+from .runner import BridgeError, Runner
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> env.Config:
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Nexus 表格列拖动 Eval（仅 table-drag.yaml）")
+    p.add_argument("--tag", help="仅运行带此标签的用例")
+    p.add_argument("--id", dest="id_substr", help="仅运行 id 含该子串的用例")
+    p.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true", help="列出每条用例而非仅失败项")
+    p.add_argument("--json", dest="as_json", action="store_true", help="输出 JSON 报告")
+    p.add_argument("--rebuild", action="store_true", help="强制重打包 Node 桥")
+    p.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=60.0, help="全局墙钟超时（秒）")
+    p.add_argument("--node", default="node", help="node 可执行文件")
+    p.add_argument("--baseline", type=float, default=1.0,
+                   help="基线通过率，用于回归对比（默认 1.0；传 -1 关闭）")
+    a = p.parse_args(argv)
+    return env.Config(
+        tag=a.tag,
+        id_substr=a.id_substr,
+        verbose=a.verbose,
+        as_json=a.as_json,
+        rebuild=a.rebuild,
+        timeout_s=a.timeout,
+        node_bin=a.node,
+        baseline_pass_rate=None if a.baseline is not None and a.baseline < 0 else a.baseline,
+    )
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    cfg = parse_args(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
+
+    cases = load_dataset()
+    cases = filter_cases(cases, cfg.tag, cfg.id_substr)
+    if not cases:
+        print("没有用例匹配给定过滤条件", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    runner = Runner(timeout_s=cfg.timeout_s, node_bin=cfg.node_bin)
+    try:
+        results = runner.run_all(cases, rebuild=cfg.rebuild)
+    except BridgeError as exc:
+        print(f"[eval] 桥构建错误：{exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    scores = Evaluator().evaluate(cases, results)
+    report = build_report(scores)
+
+    if cfg.as_json:
+        print_json(scores, report)
+    else:
+        Reporter(baseline_pass_rate=cfg.baseline_pass_rate).print_report(
+            report, scores, verbose=cfg.verbose
+        )
+
+    return 1 if report.failed else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""模块 4：Reporter —— 表格列拖动评测报告。"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+from .evaluator import EvalScore, Outcome
+
+try:
+    from rich.console import Console
+    from rich.table import Table
+
+    _HAS_RICH = True
+except ModuleNotFoundError:  # pragma: no cover
+    _HAS_RICH = False
+
+
+_BADGE = {
+    Outcome.OK: ("✅", "green"),
+    Outcome.DEGRADED: ("⚠️", "yellow"),
+    Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION: ("🧱", "red"),
+    Outcome.CRASH: ("💥", "red"),
+    Outcome.TIMEOUT: ("⏱️", "red"),
+}
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Report:
+    total: int
+    passed: int
+    warned: int
+    failed: int
+    avg_score: float
+    pass_rate: float
+
+
+def build_report(scores: list[EvalScore]) -> Report:
+    total = len(scores)
+    passed = sum(1 for s in scores if s.outcome == Outcome.OK)
+    warned = sum(1 for s in scores if not s.is_hard_failure and s.outcome != Outcome.OK)
+    failed = sum(1 for s in scores if s.is_hard_failure)
+    avg = sum(s.score for s in scores) / total if total else 0.0
+    return Report(
+        total=total,
+        passed=passed,
+        warned=warned,
+        failed=failed,
+        avg_score=avg,
+        pass_rate=(passed + warned) / total if total else 0.0,
+    )
+
+
+class Reporter:
+    def __init__(self, baseline_pass_rate: float | None = None) -> None:
+        self.baseline = baseline_pass_rate
+        self.console = Console(stderr=False) if _HAS_RICH else None
+
+    def print_report(self, report: Report, scores: list[EvalScore], verbose: bool) -> None:
+        if _HAS_RICH:
+            self._print_rich(report, scores, verbose)
+        else:
+            self._print_plain(report, scores, verbose)
+
+    def _print_rich(self, report: Report, scores: list[EvalScore], verbose: bool) -> None:
+        c = self.console
+        assert c is not None
+        c.rule("[bold]Nexus Table Drag — Eval 报告[/bold]")
+
+        show = scores if verbose else [s for s in scores if s.outcome != Outcome.OK]
+        if show:
+            table = Table(show_header=True, header_style="bold")
+            table.add_column("用例", overflow="fold")
+            table.add_column("耗时", justify="right")
+            table.add_column("结果", justify="center")
+            table.add_column("说明", overflow="fold")
+            for s in show:
+                icon, color = _BADGE[s.outcome]
+                table.add_row(
+                    s.case_id,
+                    f"{s.total_ms:.1f}ms",
+                    f"[{color}]{icon} {s.outcome.value}[/{color}]",
+                    s.reason,
+                )
+            c.print(table)
+
+        corrupt = sum(1 for s in scores if s.outcome == Outcome.TABLE_CORRUPTION)
+        ok = sum(1 for s in scores if s.outcome == Outcome.OK)
+        other = report.total - corrupt - ok
+        c.print(
+            f"通过 [green]{report.passed}[/green]  "
+            f"警告 [yellow]{report.warned}[/yellow]  "
+            f"失败 [red]{report.failed}[/red]  "
+            f"/ 共 {report.total}   |   均分 {report.avg_score:.2f}   |   "
+            f"通过率 {report.pass_rate:.0%}"
+        )
+        c.print(
+            f"表格列拖动: 共 {report.total}  "
+            f"🧱 行列错乱 {corrupt}  ✅ 守恒 {ok}  ⚠️ 其它 {other}"
+        )
+        self._print_baseline(report, rich=True)
+
+        if report.failed:
+            c.print(f"[bold red]RESULT: FAIL（{report.failed} 项硬失败）[/bold red]")
+        else:
+            c.print("[bold green]RESULT: PASS（无硬失败）[/bold green]")
+
+    def _print_plain(self, report: Report, scores: list[EvalScore], verbose: bool) -> None:
+        print("\nNexus Table Drag — Eval 报告")
+        print("=" * 64)
+        show = scores if verbose else [s for s in scores if s.outcome != Outcome.OK]
+        for s in show:
+            icon, _ = _BADGE[s.outcome]
+            print(f"  {icon} {s.outcome.value:<16} {s.total_ms:7.1f}ms  {s.case_id:<36} {s.reason}")
+        if show:
+            print("-" * 64)
+        print(
+            f"  通过 {report.passed}  警告 {report.warned}  失败 {report.failed}  "
+            f"/ 共 {report.total}  |  均分 {report.avg_score:.2f}  |  通过率 {report.pass_rate:.0%}"
+        )
+        self._print_baseline(report, rich=False)
+        print("=" * 64)
+        print(f"RESULT: {'FAIL' if report.failed else 'PASS'}")
+        print()
+
+    def _print_baseline(self, report: Report, rich: bool) -> None:
+        if self.baseline is None:
+            return
+        delta = report.pass_rate - self.baseline
+        msg = f"对比基线 {self.baseline:.0%}: {delta:+.0%}"
+        if rich and self.console is not None:
+            color = "green" if delta >= 0 else "red"
+            self.console.print(f"[{color}]{msg}[/{color}]")
+        else:
+            print(f"  {msg}")
+
+
+def to_json(scores: list[EvalScore], report: Report) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "summary": {
+            "total": report.total,
+            "pass": report.passed,
+            "warn": report.warned,
+            "fail": report.failed,
+            "avgScore": round(report.avg_score, 3),
+            "passRate": round(report.pass_rate, 3),
+        },
+        "cases": [
+            {
+                "id": s.case_id,
+                "outcome": s.outcome.value,
+                "score": s.score,
+                "passed": s.passed,
+                "hardFailure": s.is_hard_failure,
+                "reason": s.reason,
+                "tableOpMs": round(s.table_op_ms, 3),
+                "tableOp": {"moved": s.table_moved},
+            }
+            for s in scores
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def print_json(scores: list[EvalScore], report: Report) -> None:
+    json.dump(to_json(scores, report), sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")

+"""模块 2：Runner —— 驱动 table-ops-bridge 执行列拖动探针。"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import queue
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from . import env
+from .dataset import TestCase
+
+
+class BridgeError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RunResult:
+    case_id: str
+    table_op: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    missing: bool = False
+    batch_failure: str | None = None
+    table_op_missing: bool = False
+    table_op_batch_failure: str | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def table_op_ms(self) -> float:
+        return float(self.table_op.get("ms", 0.0))
+
+    @property
+    def total_ms(self) -> float:
+        return self.table_op_ms
+
+
+def _newest_mtime(paths: list[Path]) -> float:
+    newest = 0.0
+    for path in paths:
+        if path.is_dir():
+            for child in path.rglob("*"):
+                if child.is_file():
+                    newest = max(newest, child.stat().st_mtime)
+        elif path.is_file():
+            newest = max(newest, path.stat().st_mtime)
+    return newest
+
+
+class Runner:
+    def __init__(self, timeout_s: float = 60.0, node_bin: str = "node") -> None:
+        self.timeout_s = timeout_s
+        self.node_bin = node_bin
+
+    def ensure_bridge_built(self, force: bool = False) -> Path:
+        dist = env.TABLEOPS_DIST
+        sources = [
+            env.TABLEOPS_ENTRY,
+            env.PREVIEW_SETUP,
+            env.BRIDGE_CONFIG,
+            env.CORE_SRC,
+        ]
+        stale = force or not dist.exists() or _newest_mtime(sources) > dist.stat().st_mtime
+        if not stale:
+            return dist
+
+        if not env.TSUP_BIN.exists():
+            raise BridgeError(f"未找到 tsup：{env.TSUP_BIN}。请先在仓库根目录执行 `pnpm install`。")
+
+        print("[eval] 使用 tsup 打包 table-ops 桥 ...", file=sys.stderr)
+        proc = subprocess.run(
+            [str(env.TSUP_BIN)], cwd=str(env.BRIDGE_DIR), capture_output=True, text=True
+        )
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            raise BridgeError("tsup 打包失败：\n" + (proc.stderr or proc.stdout or "<无输出>"))
+        if not dist.exists():
+            raise BridgeError(f"tsup 报告成功但产物缺失：{dist}")
+        return dist
+
+    def run_all(self, cases: list[TestCase], rebuild: bool = False) -> list[RunResult]:
+        self.ensure_bridge_built(force=rebuild)
+
+        def payload(case: TestCase) -> dict[str, Any]:
+            move = case.expect.get("tableMove") or {"from": 0, "to": 1}
+            payload_dict: dict[str, Any] = {"id": case.id, "input": case.input, "move": move}
+            layout = case.expect.get("tableLayout")
+            if layout:
+                payload_dict["tableLayout"] = layout
+            if "tableIndex" in case.expect:
+                payload_dict["tableIndex"] = case.expect["tableIndex"]
+            return payload_dict
+
+        raw_results, failure_kind, stderr_lines = self._drive(env.TABLEOPS_DIST, cases, payload)
+        for line in stderr_lines:
+            print(f"[eval] table-ops stderr: {line}", file=sys.stderr)
+
+        by_id = {r.get("id"): r for r in raw_results if isinstance(r, dict)}
+        results: list[RunResult] = []
+        for index, case in enumerate(cases):
+            raw = by_id.get(case.id)
+            if raw is not None:
+                results.append(
+                    RunResult(case_id=case.id, table_op=raw.get("tableOp", {}))
+                )
+            else:
+                is_culprit = index == len(raw_results)
+                results.append(
+                    RunResult(
+                        case_id=case.id,
+                        missing=True,
+                        batch_failure=(failure_kind if is_culprit else "aborted"),
+                        table_op_missing=True,
+                        table_op_batch_failure=(failure_kind if is_culprit else "aborted"),
+                    )
+                )
+        return results
+
+    def _drive(
+        self,
+        dist: Path,
+        cases: list[TestCase],
+        payload: Callable[[TestCase], dict[str, Any]],
+    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], str | None, list[str]]:
+        proc = subprocess.Popen(
+            [self.node_bin, str(dist)],
+            stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+            text=True,
+            bufsize=1,
+        )
+
+        def write_stdin() -> None:
+            try:
+                assert proc.stdin is not None
+                for case in cases:
+                    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(payload(case)) + "\n")
+                proc.stdin.close()
+            except (BrokenPipeError, ValueError):
+                pass
+
+        out_queue: queue.Queue[str | None] = queue.Queue()
+
+        def read_stdout() -> None:
+            assert proc.stdout is not None
+            for line in proc.stdout:
+                out_queue.put(line)
+            out_queue.put(None)
+
+        threading.Thread(target=write_stdin, daemon=True).start()
+        threading.Thread(target=read_stdout, daemon=True).start()
+
+        results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.timeout_s
+        failure_kind: str | None = None
+        stdout_closed = False
+
+        while len(results) < len(cases) and not stdout_closed:
+            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+            if remaining <= 0:
+                failure_kind = "timeout"
+                break
+            try:
+                line = out_queue.get(timeout=remaining)
+            except queue.Empty:
+                failure_kind = "timeout"
+                break
+            if line is None:
+                stdout_closed = True
+                break
+            line = line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            try:
+                results.append(json.loads(line))
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                continue
+
+        if failure_kind == "timeout":
+            proc.kill()
+
+        try:
+            proc.wait(timeout=5)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            proc.kill()
+
+        stderr_text = ""
+        if proc.stderr is not None:
+            try:
+                stderr_text = proc.stderr.read()
+            except ValueError:
+                stderr_text = ""
+        stderr_lines = [ln for ln in stderr_text.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
+
+        if failure_kind is None and len(results) < len(cases):
+            failure_kind = "crash"
+        if failure_kind is None and proc.returncode not in (0, None):
+            failure_kind = "crash"
+
+        return results, failure_kind, stderr_lines

+#!/bin/sh
+# Launcher for the eval harness. Prefers the project-local venv (which has
+# rich + pyyaml installed); falls back to system python3 otherwise.
+#
+# First-time setup (creates the venv + installs deps):
+#   python3 -m venv eval/.venv && eval/.venv/bin/pip install -r eval/requirements.txt
+set -e
+
+DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
+
+if [ -x "$DIR/.venv/bin/python" ]; then
+  PY="$DIR/.venv/bin/python"
+else
+  PY="python3"
+fi
+
+# pnpm forwards a literal "--" separator; drop it so flags pass through cleanly.
+if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then
+  shift
+fi
+
+exec "$PY" "$DIR/run_eval.py" "$@"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Thin entry shim so the eval can be launched either way:
+
+    python3 eval/run_eval.py            # direct path (used by `pnpm eval`)
+    python3 -m harness.main             # module style (from within eval/)
+
+Both delegate to `harness.main.main`.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
+
+from harness.main import main  # noqa: E402
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
